column1: # S3.B CUDA commit-message trigger — must-match / must-not-match case table.
# CASE-SENSITIVE, unlike the path trigger. S3.B writes cu[A-Z]\w+ and cuda[A-Z]\w+
# with explicitly uppercase classes; folding case here would silently rewrite the
# spec's pattern into a broader one. That asymmetry is the single most likely place
# for this matcher to be wrong, so both polarities are pinned below.
